primaryTextRead.text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list section “Heleb”, lines 3098–3104; says Heldai son of Baanah appears at 1 Chronicles 27:15 and is called Heled at 11:30.

wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: この同一性は一覧記事の説明に基づくため、注記を27:15出現時に限る。

decisionNotesJa: 初出欄の修正: 初出11:30の常時欄から27:15 Heldai比較を除去し、共有記事参照を27:15へゲート。
